title: l1qw.37 leaf: Python SOS multicast endpoint POST coap://[ff02::1]/sos (R-12-036)
description: Python slice of the only live item in stale parent l1qw.37. spec/12-apps.md 18.4 R-12-036: SOS MUST be postable to the all-nodes multicast endpoint coap://[ff02::1]/sos so an unpaired node in distress can reach every node in RF range without knowing a unicast address. Today Python SosResource (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py render_post ~:202) is unicast-only; nothing binds /sos to ff02::1. Sibling multicast precedent: coap_location.c beacon uses ff02::1 NON PUT; gateway/discovery.py listens on ff02::1 for /.well-known/lichen-gw/info. Scope: register/bind the SOS POST handler for the ff02::1 all-nodes group (aiocoap multicast), reuse the existing unicast SosResource activation path (origin verification via verify_sos_origin, dedup via sos_relay, periodic via sos_periodic), add a test that a POST delivered to ff02::1 activates SOS identically to unicast. C slice (coap_server.c) is a SEPARATE follow-up — do not scope it here. Tests: extend python/tests/coap emergency SOS suite.
close_reason: Implemented Python slice of R-12-036. bind_coap_udp gains optional multicast_interface (passes aiocoap create_server_context multicast=[iface]); aiocoap joins ff02::1 and routes by Uri-Path, so POST coap://[ff02::1%iface]/sos activates SOS identically to unicast. Verified end-to-end with a real-socket probe on a physical iface before writing the test. Added TestSosMulticast to test_sos_resource.py (real socket, auto-detects multicast-routable iface, skips cleanly when none — loopback excluded since ff02::1 is unroutable on lo; LICHEN_TEST_MCAST_IFACE env override). Reuses existing unicast activation path unchanged (origin sig/seq/rate-limit gates intact). Tests: full coap suite 1896 passed, 1 pre-existing skip, 3 xfailed; SOS file 111 passed; skip path verified; ruff clean. 3x codereview (correctness/security/edge) all PASS — NOTE: opencode run reviewer delegation timed out on substantive prompts (plan agent hangs on file reads), so passes were done inline per the documented fallback; grounded against aiocoap internals (messagemanager NON-forcing for multicast, MCAST_ALL, Uri-Path dispatch). C slice (coap_server.c) is a separate follow-up per scoping. Commit 1502f60252.
